note: DEMO reference prices for Kirinyaga County, Kenya. Not AI. Every figure below was seen only in web-search summaries on 2026-10-04: the source pages (KAMIS, county and press sites, Nairobi Coffee Exchange reports) are blocked from the build machine, so no value was confirmed on an official page. A person must open each source_url, check the value and the date shown there, and set demo=false before real use. These are REFERENCE prices, never the farm-gate price: the coffee figure is the county AVERAGE paid to farmers per kg of cherry over the 2025/26 season (societies paid KES 104 to 157.40); a member's own factory pays its own rate, months after delivery, after milling, marketing and society costs. Maize and beans are wholesale market prices, not what a trader pays at the farm.
sms_note: Short strings for the PRICE/BEI SMS (card sms_precio): {fuente} = sms_fuente, {fecha} = sms_fecha. The item dates differ (coffee: 2025/26 season average reported in May 2026; maize and beans: KAMIS, date not shown), so {fecha} only says the year. Keep sms_fuente short so the SMS stays under 160 characters (scripts/make_audio.py --check tests it); it starts with DEMO while demo=true.

items.name_en: Coffee cherry: average paid to farmers, Kirinyaga County, 2025/26 season
items.method: County average of the 2025/26 cherry payouts, about KES 139 per kg of cherry (range KES 104 to 157.40 across societies and factories; about KES 134 the season before; total payout KES 7.4 billion), as reported by KBC, Citizen Digital and The Star (The Star, 2026-05-03: https://www.the-star.co.ke/counties/central/2026-05-03-page-21-main-kirinyaga-coffee-farmers-pocket-record-sh74bn-in-historic-payout-1). Announced in late April 2026. Seen only in web-search summaries. The county government page https://kirinyaga.go.ke/kirinyaga-coffee-farmers-toast-to-huge-cherry-payout-laud-government-efforts-to-revitalize-sector/ is the official page to check.
items.context: Auction reference (clean coffee, not cherry): the Nairobi Coffee Exchange Sale 42 on 2026-09-29, the last sale of the 2025/26 season, averaged KES 38,140 per 50-kg bag of clean coffee (about USD 294) (Kenya News Agency, https://www.kenyanews.go.ke/coffee-auction-closes-with-sh841m-payout-as-new-season-begins/ ; search summary; one other summary gave about KES 47,000 per bag for the same sale, so check the NCE report). The cherry payout is far lower per kg because several kg of cherry make 1 kg of clean coffee and the payout comes after milling, marketing and society costs.

items.name_en: Dry maize, wholesale, Kirinyaga County markets
items.method: KAMIS wholesale price for dry maize in Kirinyaga County, 51.11 KES/kg (retail 60 KES/kg), as shown in a web-search summary of the KAMIS site; the market and the date were not shown. 51.11 KES/kg is KES 4,600 per 90-kg bag (computed). Wholesale, not farm-gate.
items.context: Food Security Portal (IFPRI) monthly report for Kenya, August 2025 (from KAMIS data): national average retail price of white maize 69 KES/kg, Nyeri 94 KES/kg (https://ssa.foodsecurityportal.org/sites/default/files/2026-03/Monthly%20Report_Kenya_August%202025_final.pdf ; search summary).

items.method: KAMIS wholesale price for Rosecoco beans in Kirinyaga County, 111.11 KES/kg (retail 130 KES/kg), as shown in a web-search summary of the KAMIS site; the market and the date were not shown. 111.11 KES/kg is KES 10,000 per 90-kg bag (computed). Red haricot (Wairimu) beans showed 100 KES/kg wholesale, 110 retail. Wholesale, not farm-gate.
items.context: Food Security Portal (IFPRI) monthly reports for Kenya (KAMIS data) put retail bean prices in Nyeri at about 122 KES/kg against a national retail average of 107 KES/kg (2025; month not shown in the search summary; https://www.foodsecurityportal.org/sites/default/files/2026-03/Monthly%20Report_Kenya_July%202025_final.pdf).
